intro: You are given one figure and four options. One option is the same figure, only turned to a different position. The others are mirror images or have a small part changed. Find the one that is only turned.

tips.title: Pick one part and follow it
tips.body: Choose a part that is easy to spot, such as a black corner or an arrow. Turn the figure in your mind and see where that part goes. Then check a second part.
tips.caption: Watch the black dot: a quarter turn clockwise moves it one corner on.

tips.title: Go round the figure in order
tips.body: Name the parts in order as you go clockwise round the figure: box, arrow, cross, circle… Turning the figure keeps this order. A mirror image reverses it.

tips.title: Mirror images are the usual trap
tips.body: A mirror image looks right at first, but everything that should be on the left is on the right. If the order round the figure runs the other way, it is a mirror image, not a turn.

tips.title: Check the small marks last
tips.body: When two options pass the big check, look at the small things: which way a zigzag bends, which side of a line the dots are on, which way a hook points.
